bulkUpload.title: Bulk Upload
bulkUpload.subtitle: Upload multiple property listings at once using an Excel, CSV, or JSON file.

howItWorks.title: How Bulk Upload Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A quick guide before you upload your first file.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Start from the provided Excel template so your column names match exactly.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Each row in the "Listings" sheet represents a single property listing.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Do not rename, remove, or reorder the columns — the system reads them by name.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Use the same value formats shown in the sample row, e.g. booleans, coordinates, and comma-separated lists.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Upload an .xlsx, .xls, .csv, or .json file containing your listings.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Every row becomes a draft. Valid and invalid rows are both shown, with reasons for any issues.
howItWorks.step7Title: Open a draft to finish it
howItWorks.step7Desc: Open any draft to pre-fill the normal property form, fix issues, and submit it like any other listing.
howItWorks.fieldRow: Every spreadsheet row represents one property — you can upload many properties in a single file.
howItWorks.fieldColumns: Column names must stay exactly as provided; the system matches fields by column name.
howItWorks.fieldAmenities: "amenities" and "nearbyTags" must use values the system already recognizes — check the sample row for examples.
howItWorks.fieldPhotos: "photos" should be one or more image URLs, separated by commas.
howItWorks.fieldExtraProperties: "extraProperties" must be valid JSON, e.g. '{'"privatePool": true, "gardenAreaSqm": 200'}'.
howItWorks.fieldErrors: Rows with unrecognized values aren't silently accepted — every issue is reported on the draft so you can fix it.
